business_value: An ordered array of fragments concatenated into one field value. Construct the value to fulfil its assigned field purpose, preserving source-backed conditions and obligations. Surrounding text supplies any explanation or behavioral meaning the field requires.
exact_copy: Use an exact_copy object when the field uses a supplied preserved_tokens literal. Include claim_id only when the selected schema requires it. The object inserts the literal; it does not explain its use.
references: Reference objects insert supplied display values; they do not explain their use or authorize operations.
sources: Bound requirements supply the assigned meaning; context_requirements and original sources retain context. Original sources establish meaning; code samples remain context. Do not invent decisions.
clarification: A missing user decision: state known facts, the choice, its impact and the expected answer. Missing prewritten sections are not user decisions.
inconclusive: Unresolved interpretation of the supplied evidence.
